svg.text: Layout A: Dispatch all is its own button, with its own confirm
Dispatch all sits beside Hand all in the merge banner (key S on desktop). It opens a dialog (desktop) or bottom sheet (phone):
ticked finding list, then the target from findingSender's path, then one editable combined prompt. Human threads never appear.
Sample: acme-co/orders-api #365, 3 unresolved review-bot findings plus 1 person's thread. Findings 1 and 2 are fixture text; finding 3 (webhook job) is synthetic.
Desktop 1660x870, 1:1 crop around the middle pane (480 wide)
Hand all and Dispatch all share a second banner row.

g.text: The diff adds the new migration without deleting the old
version, so the duplicate version remains and migration loading
Rolling back the new migration drops the existing parcels table
on a database where the old migration already ran.
The job rescues every error, so a malformed payload retries
forever instead of stopping after the limit.
Can we rename the migration class too?
